# Project Facts

The project's internal codename is "Kestrel-9".

The staging environment is reachable at the internal hostname "orn-7.staging.internal".

The deploy pipeline requires exactly 3 approvals from the "core-infra" review team before a release ships.

The service's circuit breaker trips after 47 consecutive failed health checks.

The team's incident postmortem template lives at the internal wiki page "IR-2291".

The project's release train is named "Ferrous" and ships every third Thursday of the month.

The on-call escalation pager rotation is coordinated through the channel "#kestrel-oncall".
